prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Houston, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1357; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Houston, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had the green light and was moving slowly through the turn when the impact threw me against my seatbelt and then back into the seat. I felt immediate pain and stiffness in my neck, and I have been treated for a neck strain since then. I have described the collision the same way each time I have spoken about it, from the scene onward. I am the household member of the policyholder, and I live in the same home, so I am listed as a covered driver under this policy. I am providing this statement so the claim can be reviewed and my medical costs and vehicle damage can be addressed.
